question: In which state is the Sharavati Power Project situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

__
 
• Sharavati Power Project is situated in Karnataka.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The project is located on the river Sharavati.
 
• It rises in the western ghats.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi Hydroelectric Power Station is also situated on the river.
 
• **Jog falls **which is one of the **highest waterfalls in India** is located on this river.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
